# Find Skills Adapter

Canonical source for this skill is the user-level Copilot skill:

`%USERPROFILE%/.copilot/skills/find-skills/SKILL.md`

Load that file first and follow its referenced resources. This project file exists only to expose the same skill through the repository-level Copilot skill surface.

If the canonical source is missing, report that the shared `find-skills` skill is not installed locally.
